result.summary: Followed GIT_MERGE.md exactly. Branch feature/WF02-REQ003-REQ004 was already clean (nothing to commit) and its merge-base with origin/master equalled origin/master's tip, so the rebase was a no-op ('Current branch is up to date'). Pushed the branch (2e5f0f7..4181228, plain push, no rejection). Created PR #8 with title and body per protocol template, including 'Closes #3'. Waited for CI via `gh pr checks 8 --watch`: both `build` matrix jobs passed (1m34s, 1m16s), deploy-prod/deploy-qa correctly skipped (not on master). Squash-merged via `gh pr merge 8 --squash --delete-branch` -- GitHub-side merge succeeded (verified via `gh pr view 8 --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit`: state=MERGED, mergeCommit=6ca9863e32a4b1f1bcbd7c2939aa44bf5d18d0a5) but gh's local checkout-switch side effect landed on a stale local `master` (still at 84ff0e8, an ancestor from before GIT_SETUP branched off) which had diverged from the new origin/master squash commit, so `git pull --ff-only` correctly refused rather than silently merging. This is not the documented worktree variant (git worktree list confirmed a single worktree) but the same principle applied: verified the merge landed via the API before treating the local hiccup as anything other than a local ref update problem. Since origin/master is the sole authoritative history for a squash-merge (local master was never a live tracking branch with independent commits -- its tip was strictly an ancestor of origin/master), reset local master to origin/master with `git reset --hard origin/master` (recoverable via reflog per standing operating rules; no unpushed local work existed on master). Remote feature branch was already auto-deleted by `--delete-branch` (confirmed via `git ls-remote --heads origin feature/WF02-REQ003-REQ004` returning empty, and `git fetch --prune` reporting '[deleted] origin/feature/WF02-REQ003-REQ004'); `git branch -d feature/WF02-REQ003-REQ004` correctly reported 'not found' since this checkout worked directly on that branch rather than holding a separate local ref. All step-9 verification commands confirmed: git branch --show-current = master, git log --oneline -1 = 6ca9863 (the squash-merge commit, PR #8), git status = clean and up to date with origin/master. GitHub issue #3 confirmed auto-closed (gh issue view 3: state=CLOSED, closedAt=2026-08-28T03:31:40Z).
